Keep this page open while riding. Samples save as they arrive — a closed page's log is still here later.

Session record

Everything the app did this session, in order — connects, reads, writes, locks, warnings spoken, errors. This is the record you send when something's wrong: it says what the app did, what the board answered, and what it refused to claim.


            

            

              
              
              
            

            

          

          
        


        

          

            
Motor config — full surface

            
Every field of the board's motor config, read live. Change, review the exact write, then write — proven by read-back. Reading never writes.

            

            

              
FieldOn boardWrite

              

              
Field names and setting labels are transcribed from the firmware source — nothing is guessed. bms.limit_mode is a plain number in the firmware (it has no named settings), so it is written as a number. The separate app config (Refloat behaviour settings) is not part of the motor config and is not shown or touched by this app. 16-bit fields are clamped to what the field can hold — past that the board wraps silently, so the clamp is stated on the review sheet when it bites.

            

            
Config not read yet.

            
            
            
            
            

            

              
Profiles — one-tap switch

              
Rider profiles on the shared FloatCore profile model. Import never writes; switching is a separate, reviewed, confirmed write through the same guarded path as a manual edit — whole-profile validation before the first write, read-back proof after. App-config values in a profile are carried, never written.

              

              

              

              

                
                
                
                
              

              

              
Lend-It

              
Lend the board with a profile you defined: your exact values are captured as a restore point first, and ending the lend restores them — proven by read-back, or the lend stays open and says why.

              

                
                
              

              
Change record — versioned rollback

              
Every tune change this app writes is recorded with the exact value it replaced. Rollback restores those exact values through the same guarded path, re-validated against the safety contract first.

              

              

            

            





Community tune presets — reference only


Published rider tunes from the Float/Refloat Tune Archive and Ride Hermes, shown against Refloat v1.1.2 stock. Reference only — nothing on this card writes to the board. These are Refloat package (app-config) values: this app does not show or write app config, so a preset here is a display/carry reference, not a switch. Tap a name (or its ?) to see the full changes-from-stock table. Plain-words notes are draft copy (CANDIDATE) awaiting Tony's checkpoint. Source of record: tune-preset dossier 2026-11-25 (Tier-2 verified), pinned archive snapshot of 2026-11-25.

Changes in plain words — draft (CANDIDATE copy, Tony's checkpoint):
    

  • kp2 0.6→0.8: rate response up — snappier nose
    • 

  • kp_brake 1→1.2: braking bite up
    • 

  • kp2_brake 1→0.5: brake rate softer
    • 

  • mahony_kp 2→1.8: slightly tighter feel
    • 

  • torquetilt_strength 0.1→0.15: more nose-up under power
    • 

  • torquetilt_strength_regen 0.1→0: no regen torque tilt
    • 

  • torquetilt_start_current 15→20 A: torque tilt starts later
    • 

  • torquetilt_on/off_speed 10/8→5/5: gentler tilt motion
    • 

  • turntilt_strength 0→3: turn tilt on — carves lift nose
    • 

  • turntilt_start_angle 5→2 / start_erpm 2000→1000: turn tilt engages earlier
    • 

  • atr_strength_up/down 1/0.5→0.8/0.4: milder hill response
    • 

  • atr_threshold_up/down 1.5→0.5: ATR wakes earlier
    • 

  • atr_speed_boost 0.3→0: speed boost off
    • 

  • atr_on/off_speed 10/8→5/3: slower ATR motion
    • 

  • atr_amps_accel/decel_ratio 9/8→8/7: slightly softer ATR leverage
    • 

  • braketilt_strength 0→4: brake tilt on — tail lifts under braking
    •

Changes in plain words — draft (CANDIDATE copy, Tony's checkpoint):
    

  • kp 20→23 / kp2 0.6→0.9: firmer, snappier board
    • 

  • kp_brake 1→0.7 / kp2_brake 1→0.6: softer braking response
    • 

  • ki 0.005→0.015: stronger error correction
    • 

  • mahony_kp_roll 1.4→1.9: roll follows pitch — tighter carve feel
    • 

  • tiltback_constant 0→−1.5 at 2000 ERPM: nose drops slightly with speed — flowier, less margin
    • 

  • noseangling_speed 5→1: slower nose angling
    • 

  • torquetilt_angle_limit 8→3.5: capped torque tilt
    • 

  • turntilt_strength 0→−3: reversed turn tilt — trail-specific, unusual
    • 

  • turntilt_start_erpm 2000→100 / boost_end 5000→10000: turn tilt active almost always
    • 

  • atr_strength_up 1→1.8: much stronger uphill help
    • 

  • atr_strength_down 0.5→0.2: gentler downhill hold
    • 

  • atr_speed_boost 0.3→−0.3: reversed speed boost
    • 

  • atr_response_boost 1.5→2 / transition_boost 3→8: much faster ATR reactions
    • 

  • atr_off_speed 8→20: ATR releases fast
    • 

  • braketilt_strength 0→7: strong brake tilt
    •

Tamper watch APP-SIDE

              
Off

              
Armed here, a locked board that is touched, tilted or rolled fires the alarm flash, a loud on-screen alert and — when this device offers speech — a spoken line on this phone; where it doesn't, the alert shows on screen only and no voice is claimed. It stands guard only while the board is ON and locked, this phone is connected, and this page is open — a board that is fully OFF has nothing awake to notice a touch, in any app. The phone alert always fires; the light flash still needs the board's light module to answer (see the light check above).

              

                
              

            

          

          

            
Theft deterrent — brake hold & ladder watch PARTS A–D BENCH-PROVEN

            
App config not read yet — torque gate SHUT

            
Torque stays locked until this app reads the board's app config (Part A) in this connection.

            
Part A first: before any brake torque, this app reads the board's app config to learn its handbrake timeout — the value that releases the brake if heartbeats stop. Both known app-config layouts are accepted. A reply that arrives but does not parse ends the read at once (FINAL); retries only cover silence, and a reply landing within 10 s after a final timeout still completes the read. The manual brake controls also need the board locked (panel above): torque is only ever sent to a locked, drive-disabled board. Bench record, 2026-11-22: Part A read Tony's board at 1000 ms / 0.00 A / signature 2099347128, the 5 A micro-dose, the 15 A hold (“locked solid”) and the 25 A shudder all ran on the real board.

            

              
            

            
            

              
              
            

            

              
              
            

            
Torque locked: not connected.

            
No torque active.

            
Caps are sender-side and load-bearing: hold 15 A, shudder pulses 25 A, heartbeat every 0.5 s, 120 s total torque budget per page load, handbrake-0 on every exit path. The Refloat firmware does not clamp these — this app does. Every write on this link passes through one queue, torque first, so a torque frame can never collide with a poll. Dead-man: if this page closes or the link drops mid-hold, the heartbeats stop and the board releases the brake itself within its app-config timeout (1000 ms as read on Tony's board). That release rests on the board's own timeout setting and the heartbeat design; the page-close case has not been re-run on hardware.

            

              
Ladder watch TIER-4 FAILED 2026-11-26 — IMU FEED STARVED; ROOT-CAUSE FIX IN THIS BUILD — BENCH RE-TEST PENDING

              
Off

              
Arm the watch while connected and locked; it samples the board 10× a second.

              
The ladder: a disturbance is logged silently with an owner alert (stage 1); a board still being disturbed gets a spoken warning (stage 2); holding torque resists a carried board (stage 3); the shudder is stage 4. Every stage change is written to the log below with the values that triggered it, and if the watch loses fresh IMU data it says so — watch is blind — instead of reading calm. Stage 2's light show joins only where the light check above proved full light control; on a board whose check reports no light module the warning is voice + on-screen alert only, and no light show is claimed. Watch status, stated exactly: bench-attempted 2026-11-22, defective in bench page v3, rebuilt with logging — bench re-test pending.

              

                
                
              

              

              

                
                
              

            

            
            

              
Security — free navigation v3.16 CANDIDATE

              
Prerequisites: connect — not connected · config read — not read · lock — not locked

              
Every security function is listed here with its own readiness — nothing is hidden; a function whose prerequisite is unmet says why.

              
Handbrake tiers not armed yet — read the app config (Part A) and Lock; after that they stay armed while connected. No arm window runs and nothing expires.

              
Guard: off — one tap on Set Tamper arms the voice watch + all three rungs.

              
DATA STARVED — the ladder watch has no fresh IMU data. The watch is blind; it is NOT reading calm.

              
lights: deferred — verification SKIPPED pending the LCM update (this board's early-stock LCM has no app light control). Arm Lights stays a feature of the eventual app; the skip blocks nothing on this page, and no board light verification is claimed.

              

                
              

              
Free navigation: after connect + config read + Lock, every function on this page — Lock, Unlock, tamper watch, the handbrake tiers (5 A micro-dose, 15 A hold, 25 A shudder), lights and DISARM — is directly reachable in any order. One tap on Set Tamper arms the whole guard — the voice tamper watch AND the three-rung ladder together: rung 1, on pickup — warning + a little jerk (5 A micro-dose); rung 2, carried — the stronger wheel response (the 15 A hold) + the spoken put-the-board-down warning; five physical steps of carrying (or shaking) climb to rung 3 — full shudder (25 A) + the stolen/tracked voice line, repeating every 45 s until the board is put down and still, or DISARMED. Detection is sample-driven: it runs on each IMU sample as it arrives, and a starved feed shows DATA STARVED — never fake-calm. DISARM stands the whole guard down — engine stopped, torque released, tamper watch off — and nothing fires again until Set Tamper is tapped. Spoken wording is FINAL — all three lines approved by Tony 2026-11-25 (rungs 2/3 wording-final; their live hearing rides the ladder re-proof). Lights verification is skipped pending the LCM update and blocks nothing. DISARM cancels speech, resets the ladder and stops the repeats, and releases any ladder torque.

            

            
          

          
No chirp control exists — no command for board sound exists in the package, so none is sent. The output-disable command is never sent either: nothing on this board consults it, so it would be a placebo lock.

Advisory only. Onboard watches duty headroom, voltage sag and temperature on the live feed and calls what it sees — it never sends anything to the board. Duty bands: watch 80% · warn 88% · critical 95%, from the decision layer's own profile. The band follows duty live; spoken warnings also weigh speed and how long the condition holds, so the band can sit at WATCH in silence. Pitch and roll come from the board's IMU feed and footpads from its realtime feed — when a feed doesn't answer, its readouts show Not reported rather than an invented value.

Practice when you can't ride. FloatCore Play is the riding game that lives in this tab — same streets, same board feel, zero pavement required.

            
This tab is the practice game, standalone. It is not ghost racing — racing recorded ghosts lives on the Ghost tab, which stays racing-only.

The game starts only when you tap Launch, so the other tabs never pay its GPU cost. The game in this tab is the merged build: Stage-1 graphics (working model, Tony 2026-11-22) with the Wave 3 ghost fixes — its demo ghosts stay labelled DEMO in-game, and its physics wears the badge above until the twin-sourced port lands.
